policy: Exact source-local Sanskrit equivalents; no fuzzy CDIAL matching or automatic ancestry

review.method: Reviewed all sampled raw articles against Sanskrit spelling, transliteration, sense scope and variant sharing. Source spellings such as द्बन्द्व are preserved, not silently emended.
deliberate_cases: bare दे is a deśya label, not a Sanskrit form
दे. with a full Sanskrit equivalent retains deśya context
compound sums and abbreviated alternants stay unresolved
source-local sense keys prevent cross-sense conflation
Hindi Prakrit definitions remain context, not Sanskrit glosses
review.source_conventions: DDSA describes Sanskrit equivalents; frontmatter physical PDF p. 2 explicitly defines [दे] as देश्य-शब्द.
review.focused_tests: 60 passed; full suite deferred under local resource policy; prior unrelated manual-survey failures remain open
